releaseNotes: The assistant no longer guesses business or report IDs, keeps other names as aliases, uses exact dates, and does not turn a monthly report request into a scan schedule. Claude and ChatGPT pick the right AIReady skill more often, including for questions in other languages and questions answered without looking anything up. On AIReady Advanced, ask for what customers say about a service and approve the quotes you want to use. Ask what customers say about a service and approve the quotes you want to use, without AIReady Advanced. When a scan's AI answers mostly fail, the reply is shorter: what wasn't measured, the top fixes, and one question about retrying. AIReady's tools now spell out which ids, dates and names they expect, so assistants guess less. Ask what your competitors have changed and get each one's observed changes, with dates, most active first. Tell AIReady which competitors to watch closely, and how deeply to scan each one. Before comparing with a competitor, see exactly what was collected for it, and see which pages AI answers cite, including your own pages cited without your name. See which pages AI answers cite, including your own pages cited without your name, without AIReady Advanced. Compare yourself with a competitor check by check, and see the evidence behind each finding: the page, the date and what was observed. Choose "parity" for the competitors you want crawled as deeply as your own site. Compare how much of your city pages is shared template text with a competitor's. Compare your own licence registry and dealer listings with a competitor's. See who links to a competitor, and how its pages redirect and declare canonicals, with the date and source of each finding. See which passage of a cited page an AI answer used, where the engine reports it, and how much of a competitor's city pages is the same template text. See a competitor's licence registry and manufacturer dealer listings, and what its own site claims, before comparing. Chat can now explain why a check scored low: which signals, on which pages, with their evidence. Ask "how is my article doing?" or "should I publish on this site?" in chat: AIReady answers from your own measured AI answers and placements. Chat can now say how each AI system's mention of your business changed over a period, per location, with the same verdicts as the Trends page. Chat explains a single failed check or page from the scan's own findings.

migrations.description: The ChatGPT update archive also carries harmless replacements for files that older versions installed and the host cannot delete (the retired guide-aiready skill and old eval files).
